description: Default capabilities for Stalagmight. These grant the Tauri plugin commands the webview may call (no fs plugin command: whether a save would replace a file and the corruption-recovery salvage write are app commands, save_target_exists and write_salvaged_data, behind the write-path check); they do NOT bound the app's own commands, which take any path the webview sends. The trust boundary is that only the bundled frontend runs in the webview (strict CSP, script-src 'self'); the commands that write, replace or delete a file check its path first (src-tauri/src/commands/write_path.rs). See docs/architecture.md, IPC trust boundary.
